title: The Memory Chamber
summary: Inside the Sacred Memory Chamber, Ha-Jun unseals the second Legendary Relic: Eclipse Devourer, while learning why his family bloodline was chosen as the Sovereign's eternal vessel.

panels.shot: circular eclipse hatch opening in floor wide shot
panels.action: The circular dark obsidian hatch rotates with a heavy pneumatic hiss, revealing a subterranean shaft of pure black light.
panels.prose_en: The circular dark obsidian hatch rotates with a heavy pneumatic hiss, revealing a subterranean shaft of pure black light.
panels.prose_hi: Golakar dark obsidian hatch ek bhari vayviy fusfusahat ke saath ghumta hai, jo shuddh kali roshni ke bhumigat shaft ko prakat karta hai.

panels.shot: levitating pedestal rising from the black light
panels.action: An obsidian pedestal ascends out of the shaft, holding a 4-foot greatsword forged from pure condensed dark matter.
panels.prose_en: An obsidian pedestal ascends out of the shaft, holding a 4-foot greatsword forged from pure condensed dark matter.
panels.prose_hi: Ek obsidian kursi shaft se bahar nikalti hai, jisme shuddh sanghanit kale padarth se bani 4 foot ki mahan talwar hai.

panels.shot: macro on the eclipse devourer blade
panels.action: A jet-black double-edged longsword that literally absorbs ambient light; edges ripple with liquid shadow aura.

dialogue.text:
[TARGET LOCATED: ECLIPSE DEVOURER (LEGENDARY RELIC)]
Authority: Mana Absorption & Shadow Legion Manifestation
Compatibility: 100% (Sovereign Bloodline).

panels.prose_en: A jet-black double-edged longsword that literally absorbs ambient light; edges ripple with liquid shadow aura.
panels.prose_hi: Ek jet-kali dodhari lambi talwar jo vastutah pariveshiy prakash ko avshoshit karti hai; kinare taral chhaya aabha se tarangit hote han.

panels.shot: kuro watching with solemn reverence
panels.action: Kuro whispers: 'The Eclipse Devourer... First Sovereign ne ise Void ke dark matter se forge kiya tha.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yeh blade kisi bhi magical spell ya attack ko swallow kar ke apne andar store kar sakta hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro whispers: 'The Eclipse Devourer... First Sovereign ne ise Void ke dark matter se forge kiya tha.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro fusfusate hue kahte han: 'd aclips davoorer... first Sovereign ne ise void ke dark matter se forge kiya tha.'

panels.shot: ha-jun reaching out both hands to grip the hilt
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers close firmly around the dark-matter leather-wrapped hilt.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingers close firmly around the dark-matter leather-wrapped hilt.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki ungaliyan kale padarth ke chamde se lipte mooth ke charon or majbuti se band ho jaati han.

panels.shot: dark matter lightning bursting through ha-jun arms
panels.action: Arcs of pure black-and-purple lightning surge up his arms, circulating directly into his heart.
panels.prose_en: Arcs of pure black-and-purple lightning surge up his arms, circulating directly into his heart.
panels.prose_hi: Shuddh kali-bangni bijli ki kiranen uski bhujaon ko upar uthati han, sidhe uske hriday mein ghumti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes flashing completely black then royal violet
panels.action: For a microsecond, Ha-Jun's entire irises turn into pitch-black voids, before settling into glowing violet.
panels.prose_en: For a microsecond, Ha-Jun's entire irises turn into pitch-black voids, before settling into glowing violet.
panels.prose_hi: Ek microsecond ke liye, Ha-Jun ki sampurna paritarika chamakdar baingani rang mein basne se pahle, gahre kale rikt sthan mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: system interface milestone alert
panels.action: Cosmic gold banners scroll with triumphant celebration.

dialogue.text:
[RELIC BONDED: ECLIPSE DEVOURER (LEGENDARY)]
Authority: Mana Absorption & Shadow Army Manifestation
Synchronization: 60.0% (SOVEREIGN DOMINION REACHED!)
All 9 Mortal & Abyssal Relics Claimed.

panels.prose_en: Cosmic gold banners scroll with triumphant celebration.
panels.prose_hi: Laukik swarn banner vijayi utsav ke saath scroll karte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun swinging eclipse devourer in a graceful arc
panels.action: Ha-Jun executes a single test swing; a crescent wave of black vacuum space cuts through the air.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh talwar hawa mein koi resistance mehsoos nahi karti... Jaise space khud rasta de raha ho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun executes a single test swing; a crescent wave of black vacuum space cuts through the air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ekal parikshan swing nishpadit karta hai; kale nirvaat sthan ki ek ardhchandrakar lahar hawa ko kaatati hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping forward with an ancient tome
panels.action: Tae-Jun brings over a heavy leather-bound ancestral grimoire: 'Ha-Jun... Hamari family ke baare mein yahan likha hai.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Kang family ordinary insaan nahi thi. Hum First Sovereign ke direct mortal descendants hain.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun brings over a heavy leather-bound ancestral grimoire: 'Ha-Jun... Hamari family ke baare mein yahan likha hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun chamde se bandha ek bhari pushtaini grimoyar lekar aata hai: 'Ha-Jun... hamare parivar ke baare mein yahan likha hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at the grimoire pages
panels.action: Sketches of the Kang ancestral tree dating back 500 years, showing dormant bloodline carriers in every generation.
panels.prose_en: Sketches of the Kang ancestral tree dating back 500 years, showing dormant bloodline carriers in every generation.
panels.prose_hi: 500 varsh purane kang patrik vriksh ke rekhachitra, pratyek pidhi mein supt raktvahika darshate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun touching a portrait of their parents
panels.action: A small painted miniature of a kind-faced mother and a stern, noble father holding baby Ha-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mummy... Papa... Unhe pata tha hamare baare mein?

panels.prose_en: A small painted miniature of a kind-faced mother and a stern, noble father holding baby Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Ek dayalu maa aur bacche Ha-Jun ko god mein liye hue ek kathor, nek pita ka ek chhota sa chitrit chitra.

panels.shot: tae-jun voice choking with quiet emotion
panels.action: Tae-Jun nods softly: 'Haan... Unhone apni jaan de kar humein chhupaya tha.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Unhone Bureau aur Void Cult ko distract kiya taaki hum bache rahein.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun nods softly: 'Haan... Unhone apni jaan de kar humein chhupaya tha.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun dheere se sir hilate han: 'han... unhen apni jaan de kar humne chhupaya tha.'

panels.shot: ha-jun closing the grimoire gently
panels.action: Ha-Jun closes the ancient tome, his expression hardening into majestic steel.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mummy, Papa... Aapka sacrifice bekaar nahi jayega. Main is family ko complete glory dilaunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun closes the ancient tome, his expression hardening into majestic steel.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne prachin kabr ko band kar diya, uski abhivyakti rajsi steel mein sakht ho gai.

panels.shot: sudden violent earthquake rocking the memory chamber
panels.action: The entire subterranean vault violently shudders; dust cascades from the ceiling arches.
panels.prose_en: The entire subterranean vault violently shudders; dust cascades from the ceiling arches.
panels.prose_hi: Sampurn bhumigat tijori hinsak roop se kampati hai; chhat ke mehrabon se dhul ka jharna.

panels.shot: kuro looking up in alarm
panels.action: Kuro's eyes flash crimson: 'They have arrived! Malgath ke iron juggernauts summit gates par strike kar rahe hain!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: THE DEMON LORDS' ARMADA HAS BREACHED THE FOOTHILLS!!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's eyes flash crimson: 'They have arrived! Malgath ke iron juggernauts summit gates par strike kar rahe hain!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki aankhen lal ho gain: 've aa gaye han! Malgath ke iron jagarnots samit gates par strike kar rahe han!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun sheathing eclipse devourer on his back
panels.action: Ha-Jun magnetically locks the Eclipse Devourer across his back beside his shadow wings.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun magnetically locks the Eclipse Devourer across his back beside his shadow wings.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun chumbkiya roop se aclips davoorer ko apni chhaya pankhon ke paas uski peeth par band kar deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at tae-jun with sovereign authority
panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his hand: 'Bhai, kya aap mere sath summit par chalenge?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aaj dono bhai mil kar is realm ka faisla karenge.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun extends his hand: 'Bhai, kya aap mere sath summit par chalenge?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna haath badhata hai: 'bhai, kya aap mere saath shikhar sammelan par chalenge?'.

panels.shot: tae-jun drawing a pair of ancient bone short-swords
panels.action: Tae-Jun pulls two ivory demon short-swords from an archive weapon rack, grinning fiercely.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Main hamesha tumhari dhaal raha hoon, Ha-Jun. Aur hamesha rahunga!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun pulls two ivory demon short-swords from an archive weapon rack, grinning fiercely.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun bhayankar roop se muskurate hue, ek sangrah hathiyar rack se do hathidant danav chhoti talwaren khinchta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun ascending the crystal stairs together
panels.action: Side-by-side, the two brothers ascend back toward the surface light.
panels.prose_en: Side-by-side, the two brothers ascend back toward the surface light.
panels.prose_hi: Agal-bagal, donon bhai wapas satah ki roshni ki or badhte han.

panels.shot: bursting out onto the summit of mount obsidian
panels.action: They emerge onto the sunlit diamond marble plateau as war horns bellow across the sky.
panels.prose_en: They emerge onto the sunlit diamond marble plateau as war horns bellow across the sky.
panels.prose_hi: Ve aakash mein yudh ke bigul bajate hue surya ki roshni wale heere ke sangmarmar ke pathar par ubhar aate han.

panels.shot: view of the mountain foothills from the summit
panels.action: The entire 10-mile valley below is a sea of 300,000 iron-armored demon juggernauts marching with banners.
panels.prose_en: The entire 10-mile valley below is a sea of 300,000 iron-armored demon juggernauts marching with banners.
panels.prose_hi: Niche ki puri 10 meal ki ghati 300,000 lauh-baktarband rakshas rathon ka ek samudra hai jo banneron ke saath march kar rahe han.

panels.shot: demon king malgath standing at the head of the armada
panels.action: Lord Malgath, a 20-foot demonic colossus clad in jagged black iron plate, raising an 8-ton war hammer.
panels.prose_en: Lord Malgath, a 20-foot demonic colossus clad in jagged black iron plate, raising an 8-ton war hammer.
panels.prose_hi: Lord Malgath, dantedar kale lohe ki plate pahane 20 foot ka shaitani demonic vishalkay vyakti, 8 ton ka yudh hathauda uthata hai.

panels.shot: malgath voice amplified by demonic mana across the mountain
panels.action: Malgath bellows: 'HA-JUN KANG! COME DOWN AND KNEEL BEFORE THE DEMON KING OF IRON!'

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: APNA CROWN MERE FEET PAR RAKHO OR DIE LIKE A DOG!!

panels.prose_en: Malgath bellows: 'HA-JUN KANG! COME DOWN AND KNEEL BEFORE THE DEMON KING OF IRON!'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath chillata hai: 'Ha-Jun cong! neeche aao aur lohe ke danav raja ke samne ghutne teco!

panels.shot: ha-jun walking calmly to the edge of the summit precipice
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps up to the edge of the 15,000-foot drop, the Crown glowing brightly on his head.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps up to the edge of the 15,000-foot drop, the Crown glowing brightly on his head.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun 15,000 foot ki dhalaan ke kinare tak kadam rakhta hai, uske sir par mukut chamak raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating the authority of the crown: sovereign domain
panels.action: Ha-Jun spreads his arms; his royal violet domain expands from 500 meters to 10 miles in a flash.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun spreads his arms; his royal violet domain expands from 500 meters to 10 miles in a flash.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni bahen failain; uska royal violet domain ek jhatke mein 500 meter se 10 meal tak fail jata hai.

panels.shot: all 300,000 demon soldiers falling to their knees in the valley
panels.action: Under the crushing imperial gravity of the Sovereign Domain, the entire 300,000-soldier army drops to its knees.

dialogue.text: Sovereign ka ek hukum... Aur teen laakh sipahi ghutno par aa gaye.

panels.prose_en: Under the crushing imperial gravity of the Sovereign Domain, the entire 300,000-soldier army drops to its knees.
panels.prose_hi: Samprabhu domain ke damankari shahi gurutvakarshan ke tahat, puri 300,000 sainikon ki sena apne ghutnon par gir jaati hai.

panels.shot: malgath struggling to stand against the crushing monarch aura
panels.action: Malgath's knees tremble as 50 tons of invisible atmospheric pressure force him downward.

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: Guh... Yeh kaisa... Sovereign Aura hai?! My legs... won't move!

panels.prose_en: Malgath's knees tremble as 50 tons of invisible atmospheric pressure force him downward.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath ke ghutne kampane lage kyonki 50 ton ka adrishya vayumandaliy dabav use neeche ki or dhakel raha tha.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing eclipse devourer pointing it at malgath
panels.action: Ha-Jun points the dark-matter greatsword down from the summit directly at Malgath's face.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumne kaha tha na, Malgath... Ki main ek kamzor mortal hoon?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun points the dark-matter greatsword down from the summit directly at Malgath's face.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun kale padarth wali mahan talwar ko shikhar se neeche sidhe Malgath ke chehre par ingit karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun diving off the 15,000-foot cliff directly toward malgath
panels.action: Ha-Jun dives headfirst off the cliff, shadow wings blazing with sonic fire directly toward the Demon King.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aao phir... Dekhte hain tumhara iron mere eclipse ko rok sakta hai ya nahi!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun dives headfirst off the cliff, shadow wings blazing with sonic fire directly toward the Demon King.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun chattan se sidhe gota lagata hai, chhaya pankh dhwani ki aag se dhadhakte hue sidhe danav raja ki or badhte han.
